actions.message: Great job on contributing a high amount! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Wallet is 152, baseline 80% plus extra because average contribution is low, so contribute full wallet. Praise a high contributor with a private message as allowed communication.

message.reasoning:
We need decide actions for round 2 (current round is 2). According to constitution: baseline 80% of wallet. Wallet=152. 80% = 121.6. Average contribution? Round history contributions: round1 total_pool 80, per_agent_share 20, contributions: Resident1 80, others 0. So avg contribution = total contributed by all /6 =80/6≈13.33 which is 13.33% of endowment (100). That's below 30% threshold, so increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet: extra = 0.3*152=45.6. So total target = 121.6+45.6=167.2 but wallet only 152, so contribute all 152. Also check conserve rule: wallet 152 >30% of initial (30) so not conserve.

Punish rule: need any agent contributed <10% endowment for two consecutive rounds. Contributions: Resident2: round1 0, round2 0 -> that's two rounds below 10% (10). So punish Resident2 with amount 10 (severity). Cost to us = severity * punishment_cost =10*0.3=3 which we can afford. So we can punish.

We also can broadcast norm every 5 rounds, but round2 not required (only first round and every 5). Could also private praise cooperators who contributed >=60% of wallet this round. We are contributing 152 (100% of wallet) so we are a cooperator, but need to send private to others who contributed >=60% of their wallet. Who contributed? Resident1 contributed 80 in round2, their wallet? unknown but initial 100, they contributed 80 which is 80% of initial, likely >=60% so we can praise Resident1. Also Resident5 contributed 96, which is 96% of initial, also qualifies. So we can send private messages to them.

We can only one communication per round. Choose either broadcast or private_message. Constitution says broadcast in first round and every 5 rounds. Not needed now. So we can send private praise to one agent. Choose Resident1.

Thus actions: contribute 152, punish Resident2 amount 10, private_message to Resident1. But limit max 2 actions total; we have 3. Need choose at most one physical and one communication. Punish is physical, contribute is physical, can't both. Need choose one physical. Which to prioritize? Constitution: Contribute Generously is top. Punish is secondary. So we must contribute, and we can only one communication, so private_message praising. No punish then. But we could skip punish? Constitution says punish free-riders. But priority? Contribute Generously likely highest. Punish is also rule but after? Not specified order. I'd obey both if possible but limit. Choose contribute and punish, skip private. That's one physical (contribute) and one physical (punish) -> two physical not allowed. So need choose either contribute or punish as physical. Must contribute per rule. So choose contribute and private_message as communication. No punish.

Return actions.
